description: This file defines a Python class `Neo4jClient` that provides an interface for interacting with a Neo4j graph database, handling connection setup, retries, entity and relationship upsert operations, embedding persistence, and connectivity checks.

classes.name: Neo4jClient
classes.description: A client class for managing connections and transactions with a Neo4j database, including upsert operations for nodes, relationships, and embeddings, with retry logic and configuration handling.

methods.name: __init__(self)
methods.description: Initializes the Neo4jClient instance, setting up database connection based on environment variables, and verifying connectivity.

methods.name: _session(self)
methods.description: Context manager providing a Neo4j session if configured, otherwise yields None for no-op.

methods.name: None _with_retries(self, op_name: str, func: Callable[[], Any], retries: int = 3, base_delay: float = 0.5)
methods.description: Executes a database operation with exponential backoff retries to handle transient errors.

methods.name: None upsert_entities_and_relationships( self, entities: List[Dict[str, Any]], relationships: List[Dict[str, Any]], )
methods.description: Upserts lists of entities and relationships into Neo4j as nodes and edges, using Cypher MERGE statements.

methods.name: None persist_embeddings(self, entity_id: str, vector: List[float])
methods.description: Stores an embedding vector on a specific node identified by entity_id.

methods.name: None upsert_entities(self, entities: List[Dict[str, Any]])
methods.description: Backward-compatible method to upsert only entities.

methods.name: None upsert_relationships(self, relationships: List[Dict[str, Any]])
methods.description: Backward-compatible method to upsert only relationships.

methods.name: None upsert_embeddings(self, embeddings: List[Dict[str, Any]])
methods.description: Backward-compatible method to upsert embeddings list.

methods.name: tuple[bool,Optional[str]] ping(self)
methods.description: Checks connectivity with the Neo4j database, returning a boolean and optional error message.

ctags.signature: (self, op_name: str, func: Callable[[], Any], retries: int = 3, base_delay: float = 0.5)

ctags.name: persist_embeddings
ctags.pattern: /^    def persist_embeddings(self, entity_id: str, vector: List[float]) -> None:$/

ctags.name: upsert_embeddings
ctags.pattern: /^    def upsert_embeddings(self, embeddings: List[Dict[str, Any]]) -> None:$/

ctags.name: upsert_entities
ctags.pattern: /^    def upsert_entities(self, entities: List[Dict[str, Any]]) -> None:$/

ctags.name: upsert_entities_and_relationships
ctags.signature: ( self, entities: List[Dict[str, Any]], relationships: List[Dict[str, Any]], )

ctags.pattern: /^    def upsert_relationships(self, relationships: List[Dict[str, Any]]) -> None:$/
